description: This file contains utility functions for numeric conversions and calculations, including type casting, max/min functions, sequence generation, and mathematical operations.

methods.name: toFloat64
methods.description: Converts various types to float64, including string, int, uint, float, and bool.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts a value to int via toInt64.

methods.name: toInt64
methods.description: Converts various types to int64, including string, int, uint, float, and bool.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of multiple int64 values.

methods.name: maxf
methods.description: Returns the maximum of multiple float64 values.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of multiple int64 values.

methods.name: minf
methods.description: Returns the minimum of multiple float64 values.

methods.name: until
methods.description: Generates a sequence of integers from 0 or 1 to count.

methods.name: untilStep
methods.description: Generates a sequence of integers from start to stop with a given step.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Returns the floor of a float64 value.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description: Returns the ceiling of a float64 value.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a float64 value to a specified number of decimal places with optional rounding threshold.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a value from octal string to decimal int64.

methods.name: seq
methods.description: Generates a string sequence of integers based on provided parameters.

methods.name: intArrayToString
methods.description: Converts an array of integers to a delimited string.
